ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A small ball of mass $m = 0.1 \, \mathrm{kg}$ is thrown vertically upwards with an initial velocity of $v_{0} = 10 \, \mathrm{m/s}$ by Xiaoming and is caught at the launch point. Assume that the magnitude of the air resistance experienced by the ball is 0.1 times its weight.

1. Determine the maximum height the ball reaches during its upward trajectory.
2. Calculate the work done by gravity and air resistance during the entire process from launch to catch.
3. Calculate the time of ascent.
4. Calculate the time of descent.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A small ball of mass $m = 0.1\,\mathrm{kg}$ is thrown vertically upwards with an initial velocity of $v_0 = 10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ and is caught at the launch point. Assume that the magnitude of the air resistance experienced by the ball is 0.1 times its weight. 1. Determine the maximum height the ball reaches during its upward trajectory. 2. Calculate the work done by gravity and air resistance during the entire process from launch to catch. 3. Calculate the time of ascent. 4. Calculate the time of descent.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given m = 0.1 kg, v0 = 10 m/s, launch and catch at the same height, and air resistance magnitude f = 0.1mg. Use g = 10 m/s^2, so f = 0.1mg = 0.1 N. Upward motion: gravity and air resistance both act downward. The downward acceleration is a_up = g + 0.1g = 1.1g = 11 m/s^2. At the top, v = 0. From 0 = v0^2 - 2a_up h, h = v0^2/(2a_up) = 100/(22) = 50/11 m. The ascent time is t_up = v0/a_up = 10/11 s. Downward motion: gravity acts downward and air resistance acts upward, so the net downward acceleration is a_down = g - 0.1g = 0.9g = 9 m/s^2. Starting from rest at height h, h = (1/2)a_down t_down^2. Thus t_down = sqrt(2h/a_down) = sqrt((100/11)/9) = sqrt(100/99) = 10√11/33 s. Work over the entire launch-to-catch process: gravity has zero net work because the initial and final heights are the same, so W_G = 0. Air resistance opposes motion on both upward and downward paths. The total distance traveled is 2h, so W_f = -f(2h) = -(0.1mg)(2·50/11) = -10/11 J.
